application_order: Start with the recorded CVA6 and architectural-test revisions, then invoke harness/evaluate.sh with the complete submitted raw_checker module.

The dedicated entry selects testlist_raw_checker.yaml; the shared evaluator copies the hash-pinned raw_checker_wrap.S beside that list to verif/tests/cpu-eval-patches/raw_checker_wrap.S before running all five tests.
test_selection: One CPU-Eval directed RV32IM test places a division before register-dependent add instructions. Four pinned RISC-V Architectural Tests exercise arithmetic, shift, branch, and load dependencies.

reconstruction.test_sources: Use the pinned RISC-V Architectural Tests revision and the recorded directed source. Invoke harness/evaluate.sh; its shared evaluator supplies the local assembly source and selects all five files from the recorded test list.
